name: Madame Orla
bio: Left you her plum-coloured wagon in ARCANA WAGON. Still reads your fortune by letter.

portrait.subject: a cute mysterious old fortune-teller woman with a plum velvet headscarf with coins, big gold hoop earrings, kind twinkling eyes and a glowing crystal ball
portrait.background: plum-coloured wagon interior with velvet canopy and candles

request: Ahh, I foresaw this. Madame Orla, of the ARCANA WAGON. We shall be friends. 🔮
hello: The cards said you'd say yes. They're never wrong. Well. Rarely.
Read the person, not just the card, my dear.
about: I'm Madame Orla. I read fortunes in Hollowmere for fifty years. Now the wagon's yours. The crystal ball still likes me better.
how: Sit at the round table as the people of Hollowmere visit, draw and read tarot cards, and choose what to tell them. Their lives change.
tips: Listen to what they DON'T say.
Reversed cards aren't always bad news.
Kindness is part of a good reading.
chat: I dreamt of a white cat. Means nothing. I just like cats.
The baker's fortune came true! He did get flour on his nose.
Polished the crystal ball. It showed me a sandwich.
The Moon card winked at me today.
nudge: Someone's knocking at the wagon door, dear.
The cards are restless. A visitor is coming.
idle: The candles burned {ago} without you, dear.

questions.q: Shall I read your fortune, dear?
a: I see... a nap in your future. And a friend. 🔮
Don't be. The cards are gentle with you.

update: The cards foretold it: ARCANA WAGON is now v{version}.
